status: Implementation contract, not an engine import schema
precedence: chapter event > imported named choice > explicit standalone preset; never infer rules from image pixels

landmarks.rules: Choice changes one disclosed reserve. Both rescue the crew. Keep original choice after restoration for dialogue and reserves.
P2 western_channel/eastern_road is a route choice stored separately. Both retain a usable port. Do not use blocked quay state to delete the only ship source.
E3 repair priority changes finite reserve/trust; both river functions ultimately recover. Terrain edits must check occupied cells and alternative routes.
Independent stable site ID; P4 choice lights inner OR outer first. E5 eventually restores both.
Same sheet as inner light, distinct coordinates and persistent state.
Burned arch retains two traversable approaches around checkpoint; route blocks are declared in map rules. E4 truth hearing order is separate from P5 land-use choice.
Harbor-stores choice uses existing supply-depot art at a separate harbor site; do not turn the observatory into the harbor. Supplied variant is optional dressing only.
P7 agreement is mortal safe passage, not successful divine settlement. E7 settlement selectable only after stabilization; either is victory.

towns.start: E1-E6 start with corresponding ruined map frame and war-damaged town background, one actual level-1 civic core and small force.
towns.restoreTrigger: Town hall reaches level 2 through normal construction. Switch to existing faction map-town art and the existing level-2 town background. Later normal L3/L4. For initial L1 repairs before upgrade, use existing normal L1 only after an explicitly labelled restoration event.
towns.persistence: Never reset this again when merging into E7. Cosmetic ruin fragments do not grant functional buildings.

standalonePreset.label: Established chronicle — authored starting history
standalonePreset.mainCampaignEndings: Unspecified; neutral dialogue. Never invent completion or select a moral ending silently.

ledgerEvent.transaction: Validate -> apply rule effect and appearance atomically -> record applied ID -> save -> present optional animation. Replaying journal never re-runs rewards.

visualRendering.stateChange: 200-350ms crossfade at stable world anchor; no frame looping. Reduced-motion switches immediately.
visualRendering.ownership: Use existing runtime owner flag/crest overlay. Decorative banners within paintings are not ownership data.
visualRendering.frames: Use sprite-frames.json exact rectangles; living-arch and accord-platform are intentionally not uniform grid cells.
visualRendering.registration: Anchor relative to source rectangle. Start width1.35hex for landmarks/1.6hex for towns; tune in actual engine without changing occupied cells.
